marks.gloss_en: אמר רבא בר עולא: ונגרע מערכך -- the verse spells the root with an ayin
the word is גרעינין, with an ayin (the reading the verse's ונגרע yields; the Hebrew gives only the verse)
אמר רב יצחק בר אבדימי: ארזים לא עממהו בגן אלהים -- the verse spells the root with an ayin
dimming coals are עוממות, with an ayin (the reading the verse's עממהו yields; the Hebrew gives only the verse)
ועצם עיניו מראות ברע -- the verse spells the root with an ayin
the mishna's word is מעמצין, with an ayin (the reading the verse's ועצם yields; the Hebrew gives only the verse)
one who carries out an animal's milk -- enough to swallow
the mishna: [one is liable for carrying out] honey [in the measure] needed to put on a sore
מאי קרא? המבליג שד על עז -- the verse for the dread of the weak upon the mighty
the baraita: there are five dreads -- the dread of the weak upon the mighty
Rav: of all that the Holy One created in His world, He created not one thing for naught
דאמר שמואל: one who wants to blind a grasshopper should pull off its horns -- so a horn that broke off would blind it
the grasshopper's horn is soft because it lives among willows, and were it hard it would break off and [the grasshopper] be blinded
R' Zeira found Rav Yehuda standing at the door of his father-in-law's house and saw he was in good spirits, [such that] had he asked him all the secrets of the world he would have told him
the school of R' Yannai: [the measure for carrying out] oil is enough to anoint a small limb of a day-old child
R' Shimon ben Elazar: oil -- enough to anoint a small limb, and a day-old child
